@batches.definition: Batches are manifest-declared groups of jobs, prompts, files, sidecar calls, model routes, or tensor ops that execute under one bounded schedule.
@batches.authority: JSON declares batch membership, ordering, retry, and proof policy; XCFE/KUHUL admits and executes each unit.

fold_mapping.pop: load batch declaration and item stream
fold_mapping.wo: bind item schema, target route, and output contract
fold_mapping.yax: chunk items and select admitted execution lanes
fold_mapping.sek: execute batch chunks in deterministic order
fold_mapping.chen: reduce chunk outputs into the declared result shape
fold_mapping.xul: append replay log, hashes, and retry/error summary

rules: Batch item order must be stable before execution.
Chunks may run in parallel only when the reducer is associative or explicitly marked deterministic.
Retries must be declared; no implicit retry loop exists.
Batch outputs must include count, ok_count, error_count, and result_hash when executed.

@routes.name: batch_manifest_describe
@routes.returns: batch manifest capability and scheduling law
